races.verdict: SON OF A FISH took his form up a notch when third on nursery debut at Leicester just over a fortnight ago and with better anticipated quickly returned up to 1m, Richard Hannon's colt gets the verdict. SON OF A FISH ASTRAL CALLING (IRE) HOPE OF ACKLAM

FLOWER YOUMZAIN (IRE) WONDERVISION (IRE) EMPRESS PRINCESS (IRE)

races.verdict: This valuable event can go the way of James Fanshawe's TIKKA who looked an excellent prospect when scoring in fine style on her recent Kempton debut and can take this step up in class in her stride. races.verdict: NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK shaped as if ahead of his mark behind King Alexander in the Galway Plate and is taken to prove it back at 3m at a track that should suit his style of racing better. Funiculi Funicula must bounce back but Paul Townend keeps the faith and his natural class makes him a big danger if staying the 3m trip. Recent Galway winner Kings Hill remains of interest, with both Conyers Hill and Spread Boss Ted also respected. NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK (IRE) FUNICULI FUNICULA (FR) KINGS HILL (IRE)

races.verdict: ROND POINT showed promise in a race that's working out well at Galway in July and is taken to become the latest to frank that form by making his second start under Rules a winning one. New Grange , a winner of his sole outing in points, is a notable Rules newcomer and needs taking very seriously, especially if the market vibes are strong. Back In Favour is sure to be suited by this step up in trip and is also feared. ROND POINT NEW GRANGE (IRE) BACK IN FAVOUR (IRE)
